label: Bible Study
prompt: In the _____ was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
note: John opens like Genesis — 'In the beginning' — and then introduces the Word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is _____ of God, and knoweth God.
verse: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
note: Love runs in the family: everyone who loves is born of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Samson took hold of the two middle _____ upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
verse: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
note: Samson's last act: two middle pillars, one in each hand, and the Philistine temple came down.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the God of peace shall _____ Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verse: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
note: An echo of Genesis 3:15 — the serpent's head-crushing promise, now coming 'shortly' under the church's feet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this _____ of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
verse: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
note: Saul claimed full obedience; Samuel heard sheep. 'What meaneth then this bleating?' — caught out by livestock.
